items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 18 November 2026 4:15pm
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Wednesday, 18 November 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

There will be clear intervals and isolated showers for the remainder of the day and early tonight. Mainly light southwesterly winds will back to become mainly moderate easterly overnight. Under clear skies, temperatures will briefly dip inland to 4°C.

Cloud thickening again around midnight, bringing a scattering of showers through the rest of the night. Mainly moderate easterly winds and a minimum midnight to dawn temperature of 6°C.

Generally cloudy with showers becoming isolated tomorrow daytime, then becoming dry later. Moderate to fresh easterly winds, increasing strong in exposed places at first, with temperatures up to 9°C.

Comments: Strong wind at first.


##Outlook##

A chilly start to the day with minimum of around 2°C, but otherwise dry and mainly sunny during the daytime, a moderate northeast breeze falling light, and temperatures up to 9°C.

Comments: Risk of frost in sheltered places.
